name: leggio
description: Reads markdown the way Leggio does: a calm look for the built-in preview, with diagrams, task lists, and your own fonts and colors.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode the Google Fonts address setting is ignored.

leggio.theme.markdownDescription: The look of the markdown preview. `Default` follows VS Code's light or dark theme; the other themes keep their own colors. The settings below override the theme. Empty or null means "from the theme".

leggio.bg.description: Page background, as #rrggbb. Empty or null means "from the theme".

leggio.fg.description: Text color, as #rrggbb. Empty or null means "from the theme".

leggio.accent.description: Link and accent color, as #rrggbb. Empty or null means "from the theme".

leggio.codeBg.description: Background of inline code, as #rrggbb. Empty or null means "from the theme".

leggio.diagramTheme.description: Color theme of Mermaid diagrams. `page` follows the page colors. Empty or null means "from the theme".

leggio.fontUrl.description: A Google Fonts stylesheet address. It is the only network request the extension makes. Empty or null means "from the theme".

leggio.textFont.description: Font family for the text, as named in the Google Fonts address. Empty or null means "from the theme".

leggio.codeFont.description: Font family for code. Empty or null means "from the theme".

leggio.uiFont.description: Font family for table headers and other interface parts. Empty or null means "from the theme".

leggio.fontSize.description: Text size in px. Empty or null means "from the theme".

leggio.lineHeight.description: Line height, as a multiple of the text size. Empty or null means "from the theme".

leggio.fontWeight.description: Text weight, from 100 to 900. Empty or null means "from the theme".

leggio.codeFontSize.description: Code size in px. Empty or null means "from the theme".

leggio.contentWidth.description: Width of the text column in px. Empty or null means "from the theme".

leggio.wideWidth.description: Largest width of tables and diagrams in px. Empty or null means "from the theme".
